charts.title: HD 15906 c: orbits around HD 15906
charts.description: The orbits of HD 15906's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HD 15906 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Tuson et al. 2023 (2023MNRAS.523.3090T), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname TUSON_ET_AL__2023): P 21.583298 d
